title: hpoadj: cohort augmentation and leave-one-publication-out for HPO annotation files

creators.name: Graefe, Adam
creators.affiliation: Institute for Medical and Human Genetics, Charité Universitätsmedizin Berlin

description: Adjusts HPO annotation files (phenotype.hpoa) for phenopacket-based benchmarking of phenotype-driven diagnostic tools: adds the disease annotations implied by a curated GA4GH phenopacket cohort and removes, per publication, that publication's contribution so that no individual contributes to the disease profile it is scored against.
